scope: Documentary E1 update; own model training, tuning, pilot and benchmark reserved for E2 by user instruction. Original PDF contains empirical requirements in E1; this record does not certify a formal instructor exception.

target.definition: next value of historical rolling daily log-return standard deviation, not seven entirely future days

margin_reference: persistence on the same evaluation dates; operational criterion accepted by user, not calibrated financial utility

metric_policies.mape: positive true targets only; report coverage and zero exclusions; no arbitrary epsilon
metric_policies.mase: lag1 calendar day; denominator from permitted training only; undefined if zero/no valid pairs

independence: Temporal dependence; preserve paired dates and calendar. Final block length and seed design belong to E2.
missingness_policy: strict exclusion of incomplete daily OHLCV; no imputation; preserve missing calendar positions
selection_status: bounded corpus; attention support in a single grey manuscript; not minimum global complexity or final implementation widths
unresolved: academic adequacy of grey attention source
